versions.changelog: Polish README, clarify local/private memory positioning, side effects, quality testing, and security notes.
Harden helper script, add quality test, document side effects and temp cleanup.

- Clarified that all side-effecting operations in the diagnostic script (installing Ollama, modifying configs) require explicit user approval via flags.
- Added a new section describing script side effects and required user consent before running `--install` or `--apply-config`.
- Updated fast path instructions to recommend a diagnostic-only run before any actions with side effects.
- No functional changes; documentation improvements only.

**Summary:** Diagnostic and setup process now centers on a new check script; install/setup script removed.

- Added `scripts/check-ollama-memory.sh` to diagnose, install, and validate Ollama-based memory search.
- Removed `scripts/setup.sh`; step-by-step installation is now integrated into the diagnostic script.
- SKILL.md fully rewritten for clarity, featuring new fast diagnostic workflow, explicit safety notes, and improved validation steps.
- Now supports both `nomic-embed-text` and `qwen` embedding models via Ollama, where supported.
- Troubleshooting guidance clarified and refocused on real-world diagnostic outcomes.

Initial release — enables local semantic memory search with Ollama for OpenClaw.

- Provides a local, private alternative to node-llama-cpp using Ollama’s embedding API.
- Fixes errors when node-llama-cpp is missing or fails by routing embeddings via Ollama and nomic-embed-text.
- No external API keys or cloud required; works fully offline on macOS and Linux.
- Includes both automatic and manual setup instructions.
- Troubleshooting guide provided for common issues.
